svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 JWT 认证、授权、Refresh 与 WebSocket

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 JWT 认证、授权、Refresh 与 WebSocket
create empty SecurityContext and set Authentication
tenant/customer REST rate limit after auth
Access expired: browser refresh and retry
new access + new refresh + new jti, same sessionId
retry original request with new access
Refresh does not check password age or 2FA.
The previous refresh token is not marked as used and remains reusable.
use stored securityCtx without reparsing JWT
Token expiration, logout, or password invalidation after connection
does not automatically close the established WebSocket.
admin pair signed with new key
async notification delivery to other services
There is no dual-key grace period or all-node barrier.
During propagation, old and new tokens may be accepted by different nodes.
Invalidation cache TTL still comes from YAML refreshTokenExpTime at startup.
